snippet.title: Anime Dream Match: Rodents Trailer
snippet.description:
This game on Steam store: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3942840/Anime_Dream_Match_Rodents/

Anime Dream Match: Rodents is a delightful and soothing memory game featuring captivating artwork of adorable anime rodents. Test and enhance your memory skills by finding matching pairs of images to complete each level. As you progress, the game becomes more challenging and exciting, offering a truly enjoyable experience.

Immerse yourself in a cute and calming world, perfect for relaxing and sharpening your memory!

Features of Anime Dream Match: Rodents:

• 50 engaging levels
• Beautifully crafted anime art
• Simple and intuitive controls (mouse)
• Achievements to unlock
• Relaxing and charmng music
